jen-smith: Heads-up team — planning a config flip called `auth-rateflip` at 2026-03-17 15:00 UTC (no DB migrations). Need a quick runbook sanity check and someone to own the revert path if smoke fails. ping @suresh_p @alex_k @maria_g

alex_k: I'm free for that window. Confirming: pure config toggle, no schema changes? If so I can be revert lead and standby in ~5m.

maria_g: Confirmed no DB changes. I can take rollback if needed. Will follow runbook steps and coordinate with oncall.

suresh_p: I'll handle monitoring and paging. Which signals should we treat as immediate rollback triggers? Give thresholds so I can patch alerts.

jen-smith: Proposed rollback gates: - p95 latency increase >30% vs baseline OR absolute p95 > 700ms for 2m; - 5xx rate >0.4% sustained for 3m; - token-serve time p95 > 1.3x baseline; - sudden cache-miss or prefix error traces spike. If any one meets condition, call for revert.

devops-bot: Canary plan: 5% of traffic for 8m, then 25% for 7m, then 100% if no alerts. Auto-fallback toggles enabled. Deploy will tag rollout-id `auth-rateflip-20260317`.

maria_g: Runbook check — here's the minimal revert I propose, and a small safety tweak to avoid stale keys: 

``
1) pause rollout: rctl rollout pause --id auth-rateflip-20260317
2) re-pin config: rctl config promote --service auth --from v2.14
3) restart auth service group: svcctl restart -g auth-prod
4) prune KV cache keys scoped to session prefixes (avoid full flush)
5) monitor metrics for 6m and confirm health
```

alex_k: For step 4, prefer scoped deletion. Suggest: `redis-cli --scan --pattern 'prefix:session:*' | xargs -r -n 100 redis-cli del` so we don't slam Redis. Add a short backoff loop.

jen-smith: Agree — we'll use the scoped delete. Proposed exact command to add to runbook: `redis-cli --scan --pattern 'prefix:session:*' | xargs -r -n 100 redis-cli del && sleep 2` — I'll add a note to run it from the ops bastion.

suresh_p: I'll create temporary alerts for the window: - page if 5xx > 0.4% for 3m; - page if p95 latency > 750ms for 2m; - slack-only warning if token-serve p95 > 1.25x baseline. If page goes out, I'll call for rollback.

qa-bot: Smoke checklist (to run in canary): 1) health endpoints OK across 3 canary hosts; 2) functional auth smoke tests pass (login, token refresh) within SLO; 3) no uptick in error budget; 4) tracing shows no new high-latency spans. Post-canary run full acceptance.

devex: I'll watch the runbook doc and be ready to DM step-by-step if something diverges. I can also help with the Redis prune script in case of failures.

jen-smith: Thanks all. Final call: please react with :white_check_mark: if you're available and own the items above for 15:00 UTC. I'll post an announce 10m prior and start the canary at the scheduled time.

maria_g: :white_check_mark:

alex_k: :white_check_mark:

suresh_p: :white_check_mark:

devex: :white_check_mark:

jen-smith: Copy — closing prep. Will update runbook with the exact redis prune command and the alert thresholds.
